issues.description: The script dynamically loads and executes remote JavaScript code using fetch and new Function, allowing arbitrary code execution from any URL passed to loadscript().
issues.recommendation: Avoid dynamic code execution from remote sources. Only load trusted, versioned scripts and validate URLs.

issues.description: The script references an external key retrieval page (https://wexi.qzz.io/key) and encourages users to visit it, potentially exposing users to phishing or malicious content.
issues.recommendation: Ensure the external key page is trustworthy and does not collect sensitive information.

issues.description: The script stores the user-provided access key in localStorage, which is accessible to any script running on the same domain.
issues.recommendation: Consider encrypting sensitive keys or using more secure storage mechanisms.

issues.description: The script uses new Function to execute fetched code, which is equivalent to eval and poses a high security risk.
issues.recommendation: Avoid using new Function or eval for executing remote code.

issues.description: The script deletes the IndexedDB database 'UnityCache', which may disrupt normal game operation or cause loss of cached data.
issues.recommendation: Warn users before deleting browser storage and ensure it is necessary.

issues.description: The script requests no @grant permissions, but uses localStorage and indexedDB, which are accessible in the page context.
issues.recommendation: Review permission usage and minimize access to sensitive APIs.

details: Stores user access key in localStorage
